entities.title: Candidate
entities.summary: A file the scan judged worth compressing, recorded in the cands table with its estimated saving and a status.
notToBeConfusedWith: A recorded file: every regular file the scan saw is recorded in the files table for dedupe, candidate or not.

entities.title: State file
entities.summary: The SQLite database at $FDS_STATE or ~/.local/state/free-disk-space/scan.sqlite3 that holds one scan and what compress and dedupe did with it.
notToBeConfusedWith: The daemon's log, which is a separate text file

entities.title: Data volume
entities.summary: /System/Volumes/Data where it exists, else /: the volume whose free space every command reports and the daemon watches.
notToBeConfusedWith: The volume a particular file is on, which can differ when a scan crosses devices

entities.title: Name group
entities.summary: Recorded files that share a leaf name, extension included, and a size; dedupe hashes only within a group.

entities.title: Kept copy
entities.summary: In a set of identical files on one volume, the file the others become clones of: one that may not be replaced if there is one, otherwise the oldest.

entities.title: System file
entities.summary: For dedupe, a file owned by root or by another user, or under /Library, /Applications, /private, /etc, /var, /tmp or a scan skip prefix; left alone unless --include-system.

entities.title: Dev artifact
entities.summary: A directory under the dev root with a known build-output or dependency name (node_modules, target, dist and the rest) that clean may delete once it proves it regenerable, old and unused.

entities.title: Protected entry
entities.summary: Something clean tried to remove or read and could not, usually for lack of permission; it is listed and skipped.
notToBeConfusedWith: Kept artifact: one clean chose not to delete because it was modified today or in use

entities.title: Uncertain entry
entities.summary: A dev artifact clean could not prove safe to delete (no manifest or lockfile, not git-ignored, tracked files, no process snapshot, or changed before deletion); it is listed and left untouched.

entities.title: Awake time
entities.summary: Time the Mac has been awake, from a clock that stops during sleep; the daemon's cadence is measured in it.

entities.title: Dry run
entities.summary: A run that reports what it would do and changes nothing: clean and dedupe without --apply, and compress --dry-run.
